tabDesc.general: Audio source, speech recognition, and the live captioning controls.
tabDesc.captionStyle: Font, color, and layout for the caption overlay.
tabDesc.translation: Translate captions into another language as they appear.
tabDesc.models: Manage downloaded speech and translation models.

general.audioTestHint: Confirms audio from the selected source reaches the Rust backend — the bar should move.
general.speechHint: Use the Live captioning switch in the sidebar to start or stop. First run downloads the Whisper speech model (~140MB); captions appear in the overlay window a few seconds behind live speech.
general.clickThroughHint: When enabled (default), clicks pass straight through the caption overlay to whatever is behind it. Disable this temporarily to drag or resize the overlay window.
general.autoStartCaptioning: Start captioning automatically on app launch

captionStyle.dragHint: Drag the caption overlay window directly to reposition it, and resize it from its edges. Position and size are saved automatically.

translation.localUnsupportedHint: Local translation currently supports Spanish, French, German, and Chinese. Other languages need the cloud provider (coming soon), or downloads a model that may not exist and captioning will fall back to showing the original text only.
translation.localAssumptionHint: Local translation currently assumes the spoken language is English. On first use it downloads a ~250MB model for the selected target language.

apiKey.placeholderSaved: Key saved (enter a new one to replace)
apiKey.savedHint: A key is saved in your OS credential store.

models.intro: Local speech recognition and translation models are downloaded on demand the first time you use them.

fontPicker.substituted: Font "{{font}}" is missing some letters, so "{{fallback}}" is used for captions instead.
